monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured in the repository. The conversion improvement is a product-neutral infusion-appliance comparison, cost, and return-window acceptance system. It does not name or rank a merchant or model, publish live prices, invent testing, or force a purchase; safe existing equipment or buying nothing remains a valid outcome.

image_qa.note: All three new editorial pages use original text, evidence tables, checklists, and existing brand interface assets. No symbol artwork, appliance photo, cultivar photo, stock image, merchant image, affiliate image, or generated image was added or changed. The Abacus field note explicitly withholds a cultivar image because no exact licensed photograph was verified.

search_console.decision: The October 12–November 8 report is two days old and valid: 815 impressions, three clicks, 0.368% CTR, and average position 24.093. Arkansas was the only page-level signal with more than a token sample in the target 4–20 band, and that established URL was materially improved on November 12; repeating it today would add no distinct reader purpose. The 510-versus-disposable row had two impressions and already maps to a complete existing page, Delaware had only two impressions, Blue Dream was near position 48, and the remaining rows were single-impression noise. Those signals were deliberately ignored as already addressed, duplicative, too small, or out of range. No item in this batch is labeled Data-led; the report acted as a cannibalization and diversity guard.

authority.action: Published a citation-worthy, cross-jurisdiction warning-symbol reference built from current New York, California, Colorado, and Minnesota primary sources. Its comparison matrix, six-question evidence map, unknown-icon workflow, publisher checklist, and official-source directory are reciprocally linked from established label, glossary, package-condition, and source pages. The infusion guide also strengthens the shared-kitchen, edibles, cleaning, and comparison cluster. No speculative outreach target was logged and no outreach was sent.
